d: Deep espresso brown hair is styled into a high ponytail with long, sweeping strands and straight-cut bangs. The eyes are a vivid amethyst purple with a sharp, neutral expression on a youthful, teenage face. The build is slender, dressed in a black school-style blazer over a black shirt and red tie, paired with a short black pleated skirt, sheer black tights, and black ankle boots, all layered under a draped grey and white hooded jacket. Signature details include a black utility belt with silver buckles, a hanging silver chain with star-shaped charms, black fingerless gloves, and a massive black mechanical sword with red accents.
